pages.title: Bioreactor
pages.text: A sterile, stirred, temperature-held vat where cells grow and do the chemistry for you.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Grows cultures in $(fluid)Nutrient Broth$(): cells, enzymes, tardigrades and organoids.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 3 fluid inputs, 2 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Anomalous Strain Culture, CAR-T Cell Culture, Engineered Enzyme, Immortal Cell Line, Morphogenic Serum, Neural Organoid, Nutrient Broth, Quantum Chlorophyll, Stem Cell Culture, Tardigrade Culture, Tumour Microenvironment Organoid, Tumour Specimen, Xenobot Swarm, Xenoplasm.
$(fluid)Nutrient Broth$(). Made in $(item)Chemical Reactor$().$(br)Used for: Anomalous Strain Culture, Antibody, CAR-T Cell Culture, Circadian Culture, Cryptochrome Magnetoreceptor.
